controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "We believe our underwriting philosophy and initiatives can generate an average GAAP combined ratio over any five-year period that is consistently within the range of 92% to 98%. For the first six months of 2026, our GAAP combined ratio was 98.2%" ; 10-K FY2025 : "our underwriting profitability target of a GAAP combined ratio over any five-year period that consistently averages within the range of 92% to 98%"
controles.correction_proposee: Double erreur : 98,2% est AU-DESSUS de la borne haute de 98%, et la cible porte sur une MOYENNE sur cinq ans, pas sur un semestre. Ecrire : "le ratio combine semestriel ressort a 98,2%, juste au-dessus de la borne haute de la cible de moyenne quinquennale de la societe (92% a 98%)". Meme correction a appliquer dans le resume.
